summary: This bill authorizes the use of Department of Justice grant programs, specifically Byrne and COPS grants, to fund the purchase and operation of unmanned aircraft systems (drones) for public safety purposes.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends existing acts to allow Department of Justice grants (Byrne and COPS) to be used for purchasing and operating unmanned aircraft systems (drones) for public safety. This enhances law enforcement capabilities, aligning with a stricter justice and stronger policing approach.
